operating_notes.text: Integrated drilling services contract with Antelopus Selan Energy Limited extended for 30 months from 1 July 2026 at an estimated USD 8.28 million (about ₹78 Cr).
FY26 exceptional item of ₹20,828.49 lakh (₹208.28 Cr) is a one-time, non-cash write-off of legacy Kandla Energy & Chemicals trade receivables.

Consolidated trade receivables include old trade receivables of Dolphin Offshore Group of Rs. 14,100.00 Lakhs and Dolphin Offshore Shipping Limited of Rs. 2,011.22 Lakhs pertaining to old outstanding from erstwhile business before acquisiti
FY26 exceptional item of ₹208.28 Cr is a one-time, non-cash write-off of legacy Kandla Energy & Chemicals trade receivables after a 12-month reconciliation and recovery programme.
FY26 operating cash flow of ₹270.09 Cr was 137% of net profit, with capex of ₹236.45 Cr and free cash flow of ₹33.64 Cr.
The company operates in a single business segment, Oil and Gas Field Services, and does not report segment-wise revenue under Ind AS 108.
Order book above ₹3,000 Cr consists of one 15-year contract and the rest averaging 2.5 years; over ₹800 Cr to be executed in FY27.
Rigs are 100% utilised; gas processing has 12-15% spare capacity before new capex is needed.
Dolphin Group trade receivables of ₹160 Cr remain on the books, held on the strength of arbitration awards in the company's favour.

timeline.summary: On April 27, 2026, Deep Industries shareholders approved amending the main object clause and appointing Mr. Shalin Harshadbhai Patel as independent director via postal ballot.
Promoter **Paras Shantilal Savla** and group collectively hold **63.49%** of Deep Industries Limited’s equity shares as of **March 31, 2026**, with no encumbrances declared.

On 7 May 2026, Deep Industries disclosed a 30-month extension of its integrated drilling services contract with Antelopus Selan Energy Limited from 1 July 2026, valued at USD 8.28 million (about ₹78 Cr).
On 14 May 2026, Deep Industries reported audited consolidated FY26 results with a ₹208.28 Cr exceptional write-off of legacy Kandla receivables and recommended a ₹2.50 final dividend.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹248.71 Cr, net loss to shareholders ₹14.36 Cr (against a loss of ₹209.17 Cr a year earlier).
Deep Industries Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 on 15th May 2026 via its website.
On 15 May 2026, Deep Industries' Q4/FY26 earnings call guided FY27-28 growth of 25-30% YoY, EBITDA margin of 44-45%, FY27 capex of about ₹300 Cr, and said the planned QIP would not proceed.
